label: Manual Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow when a user clicks Run.

label: Webhook Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow when an HTTP request hits its webhook URL.

label: Schedule Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow on a cron schedule (e.g. every weekday 9am).

label: Interval Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow on a fixed time interval.

label: Workflow Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow when another workflow completes.

label: Event Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow when a matching platform event is published.

label: Email Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow when an email arrives in a monitored inbox.

label: File Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow when a file appears or changes in a watched path.

label: Error Trigger
purpose: Starts the workflow when an error/event of a given code is raised.

label: HTTP Poll Trigger
purpose: Periodically polls an endpoint and starts the workflow with its response.

label: HTTP Request
purpose: Calls an external HTTP endpoint and captures the response.

label: GraphQL Request
purpose: Executes a GraphQL query or mutation against an endpoint.

label: API Health Check
purpose: Probes an endpoint and reports status, latency, and a healthy flag.

label: API Poll
purpose: Polls an endpoint until a condition is met or a poll budget is exhausted.

label: Webhook Response
purpose: Shapes the response returned to an inbound webhook call.

label: Download File
purpose: Downloads a remote file to a local path (or inline) and reports the result.

label: Upload File
purpose: Uploads a local file (or inline content) to an endpoint as multipart form data.

label: HTTP Batch
purpose: Runs a list of HTTP requests and returns their results in order.

label: HTTP Retry
purpose: Calls an endpoint with its own retry/backoff loop, returning the final result.

label: Wait for HTTP
purpose: Waits until an endpoint returns a desired status (or the timeout elapses).

label: Rate Limited Request
purpose: Makes a single request paced by a configurable requests-per-second budget.

label: Paginated API Request
purpose: Walks an API's pages and concatenates the collected items.

label: AI Agent
purpose: Runs an AI agent with instructions and returns its completion.

label: LLM Chat
purpose: A single-turn chat completion with system instructions and user input.

label: AI Router
purpose: Asks the model to decide which of the named routes the input belongs to.

label: AI Decision
purpose: Asks the model for a yes/no decision with a confidence and rationale.

label: Text Classifier
purpose: Classifies input text into one of the configured categories.

label: Text Summarizer
purpose: Produces a concise summary of the input text.

label: Sentiment Analyzer
purpose: Returns the sentiment of the input text (positive/negative/neutral, score).

label: Entity Extractor
purpose: Extracts named entities (people, orgs, places, dates, …) from text.

label: Information Extractor
purpose: Extracts structured fields described by the config from a document.

label: JSON Generator
purpose: Generates JSON that matches a described shape from the input.

label: AI Data Validator
purpose: Validates data against stated rules and returns pass/fail with findings.

label: AI Content Generator
purpose: Generates content (copy, drafts, replies) from a brief and style guidance.

label: AI Researcher
purpose: Answers a question using the supplied context, with a source-grounded answer.

label: AI Root Cause Analyzer
purpose: Analyzes failure evidence and returns likely causes with confidence.

label: AI Anomaly Investigator
purpose: Investigates an anomaly from an evidence package and reports likely causes.

label: If/Else
purpose: Evaluates one or more expressions and branches to true or false.

label: Condition
purpose: Evaluates an expression and branches to true or false.

label: Switch
purpose: Routes based on a value against up to four cases, else a default.

label: Router
purpose: Routes based on regular expressions against up to six routes, else fallback.

label: Filter
purpose: Keeps or drops items of an array that satisfy a predicate.

label: Merge
purpose: Combines objects (shallow) or concatenates arrays from multiple sources.

label: Split
purpose: Splits a string by a delimiter, or chunks an array into parts.

label: For Each
purpose: Maps every item of an array through a template into an output array.

label: Loop
purpose: Builds an array by applying a mapping N times.

label: While
purpose: Iterates a bounded mapping while a condition holds.

label: Wait
purpose: Pauses the workflow for an interpolated duration.

label: Delay
purpose: Pauses the workflow for a fixed duration.

label: Conditional Wait
purpose: Pauses until an expression over the variables becomes true.

label: Human Approval
purpose: Pauses until a human approves or rejects, then branches.

label: Try/Catch
purpose: Passes a payload through; a guard marker for protected sub-graphs.

label: Stop/Fail
purpose: Stops the run — either failing it or ending it early with a message.

label: Retry
purpose: Declares a retry policy for downstream work and records it on each pass.

label: Exponential Backoff
purpose: Waits an exponentially-growing delay, then passes data through.

label: Timeout
purpose: Fails the run when a measured upstream duration exceeds a budget.

label: Circuit Breaker
purpose: Opens or closes based on a measured metric against a threshold.

label: Rate Limiter
purpose: Assesses an observed rate against a budget and branches ok/exceeded.

label: Deduplicate
purpose: Skips a duplicate payload by key; the first occurrence passes through.

label: Idempotency Check
purpose: Reports whether a key was already processed and passes it either way.

label: Error Handler
purpose: Sanitizes and annotates an upstream error message, then routes handled/risky.

label: Dead Letter Queue
purpose: Records a payload as undeliverable and returns the DLQ entry.

label: Set Fields
purpose: Sets (adds/overrides) fields on the incoming object.

label: Map Fields
purpose: Renames and reshapes fields via a key mapping.

label: Rename Fields
purpose: Renames selected keys, keeping everything else.

label: Remove Fields
purpose: Removes selected keys from the incoming object.

label: JSON Parse
purpose: Parses a JSON string into a value.

label: JSON Stringify
purpose: Serializes a value to a JSON string.

label: CSV Parse
purpose: Parses a delimited text table into rows of values.

label: CSV Generate
purpose: Serializes an array of objects into delimited text.

label: XML Parse
purpose: Parses an XML document into a JSON tree.

label: Regex Extract
purpose: Extracts a capture group from text by pattern.

label: Text Formatter
purpose: Applies a text operation: case, trim, replace, truncate, pad.

label: Date Formatter
purpose: Formats, adds, or subtracts time from a date.

label: Transform
purpose: Builds an output object from a configurable field mapping.

label: Template
purpose: Renders a template with {{variable}} interpolation to text.

label: PostgreSQL
purpose: Runs SQL against a PostgreSQL database via its JDBC driver.

label: MySQL
purpose: Runs SQL against a MySQL/MariaDB database via its JDBC driver.

label: MongoDB
purpose: Runs a find/insert operation against a MongoDB database.

label: Redis Get
purpose: Reads a value by key from a Redis server.

label: Redis Set
purpose: Writes a value by key to a Redis server.

label: Database Query
purpose: Runs a read (SELECT) against a JDBC database and returns the rows.

label: Database Insert
purpose: Runs an INSERT against a JDBC database and returns the affected count.

label: Database Update
purpose: Runs an UPDATE against a JDBC database and returns the affected count.

label: Database Delete
purpose: Runs a DELETE against a JDBC database and returns the affected count.

label: Database Transaction
purpose: Runs a list of statements in one transaction with commit or rollback.

label: Telegram
purpose: Sends a message through the connected Telegram BOT integration.

label: Twilio
purpose: Sends an SMS through the connected Twilio integration.

label: Stripe
purpose: Retrieves customer or transaction info via connected Stripe integration.

label: OpenAI
purpose: Runs chat completions via connected OpenAI integration.

label: HubSpot
purpose: Creates contacts or deals via connected HubSpot integration.

label: Slack
purpose: Posts a message to Slack through the connected Slack integration.

label: Notification
purpose: Sends a notification through a connected notification provider.

label: Discord
purpose: Posts a message to Discord through the connected Discord integration.

label: Microsoft Teams
purpose: Posts a message to a Teams channel through the connected Teams integration.

label: Email
purpose: Sends an email through the connected SMTP integration.

label: Gmail
purpose: Sends email through Gmail's SMTP relays via a connected email integration.

label: Google Sheets Append Row
purpose: Appends a row to a Google Sheet.

label: Linear Create Issue
purpose: Creates an issue in Linear through the connected integration.

label: GitHub Create Issue
purpose: Creates an issue in GitHub through the connected integration.

label: Salesforce Create Lead
purpose: Creates a lead in Salesforce.

label: PagerDuty Trigger Incident
purpose: Triggers an incident in PagerDuty.

label: Jira
purpose: Creates a Jira issue via the Jira Cloud REST API.

label: Notion Create Page
purpose: Creates a page in a Notion database.

label: S3 Upload
purpose: Uploads content to an AWS S3 bucket.

label: Execution Monitor
purpose: Reads an execution status/summary from the variables and reports it.

label: Health Check
purpose: Evaluates named checks against values and branches healthy/unhealthy.

label: SLA Monitor
purpose: Assesses success rate and latency against an SLA and branches inSla/breached.

label: Anomaly Detector
purpose: Flags outliers in a numeric series using a median-absolute-deviation gate.

label: Incident Creator
purpose: Creates an incident record and notifies the configured channel.

label: Escalation
purpose: Escalates the run to a channel with stepped urgency.
